row:
Maria Ines Gay da Fonseca Allgayer is a Brazilian DVM and Equine Therapist with larger experience as an equine practitioner for more the 20 years. She has worked as a veterinarian in equine clinic and surgery in several equine practices and Stud Books in Brazil from 2000 to 2004. In 2005, Dr. Allgayer opened her own practice “Equivet” and in 2007 she opened her first Equine Rehabilitation Center. 
In 2011, she moved to the U.S. and opened her first Equine Rehabilitation Center, Therapy4Horses, Oklahoma. 
In 2016, Dr. Allgayer was invited to be member of the Veterinary Equine Therapist Team for the Olympic International Committee of the 2016 Olympic Games in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
 In 2018, she was a member of the Uruguayan and Argentinian Veterinary Team for the World Equestrian Games held in Mill Spring, North Carolina, U.S. 
Since 2014, she has been offering courses in Equine Rehabilitation in her own facilities.
